title: From Traces to Witnessed Contracts: Incremental Precondition-Effect Compilation for LLM Agent Skills (Software and Reproducibility Artifacts)
description:
This versioned archive contains the implementation, frozen protocols, native execution records, model-control outputs, tests, analysis, results, and manuscript sources for Incremental Witnessed Contract Compilation (IWCC).

IWCC compiles successful ALFWorld and ScienceWorld traces into deterministic, provenance-carrying structural contracts and screens complete skill-program revisions before environment execution. The frozen confirmation contains 60 zero-overlap tasks and 300 candidate programs. IWCC achieved 88.12% balanced accuracy, a 10.64-point absolute gain over the strongest predeclared comparator (task-stratified 95% CI 8.88-12.50 points; paired permutation p = 9.9999e-6), with zero false rejections among 98 controls.

The archive includes integrity manifests and CPU-only verification scripts. Third-party ALFWorld data and model weights are not redistributed. The pinned ScienceWorld JAR is redistributed under Apache-2.0 with its license and notice.
